description: Repairs r-sort-3b/image-build-order-b: the intermediate files[...] captures were size-only (unread: IOException 0x80070020, file in use), so the states between index builds could not be compared although the final sizes were equal and the hashes differed. New General ACCDB. T(ID Long primary key, K TEXT(40)) with the first 24 pair-corpus values in ID order; then the indexes IX3 (K, ID), IX2 (K DESC), IX1 (K) are built one after another, each in its own read/write open of the closed file, with a whole-file image kept after each close. Reads the IX1, IX2 and IX3 walks and every index's refreshed metadata through a read-only open. Asks what each index build changes in the file and whether the order of builds changes the final image, the walks or the reported index order (the build order reversed is sort3b-image-build-order-a).
retentionNote: Designed r-fix-fmt-sort probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
